reviewType: Independent native-source visual and pixel review
scope: Exact Confederate A SOUTH v14 native source; limited local opt-in preview only

nativePixelEvidence.coloredRGBAssessment: Targeted red/yellow samples occur only at alpha1/2/4; nearly transparent RGB is overemphasized by the native viewer. This diagnostic does not prove perfectly clean transparency or exhaustive absence of fringe.

verdict: PASS for exact-source local opt-in SOUTH action preview, with limited action continuity and 2D registration uncertainty

appearance.kit: Gray kepi-like cap and worn gray jacket, tan trousers, brown boots, brown crossed straps, tan upper-back roll and round tan side canteen, dark belt pouches appear consistently in all four cells.
appearance.referenceContinuity: Broad kit/palette compared visually with retained v13 Confederate A E actions source. This front view adds a visible fuller beard and changes apparent body span; exact face, skeleton and manufactured equipment continuity is not established.

bearingAndGrip.bearing: Chest, shoulders, cap brim/head, paired front trouser legs and toes are visible from an elevated front camera in every cell; no cell becomes native N rear or a lateral side profile. Fire weapon projects toward viewer/screen-down-left with a foreshortened stock-to-mouth axis.
bearingAndGrip.grip: Ready shows two separated grips on the upright weapon; fire shows one hand at rear stock/trigger region and the other supporting fore-end; loading shows one hand above mouth while the other steadies weapon; ramming shows raised rod-hand and lower steadying hand.
bearingAndGrip.limits: Fingers, hidden pelvis and shoulder stock attachment have occlusion/2D uncertainty. The fire weapon has down-left yaw; exact optical camera angle, ballistic axis, physical anatomy and drill are not certified.

cells.name: TL ready
cells.observation: Upright ready weapon; both planted boots visible, with two hands separated along the stock/fore-end.

cells.name: TR fire
cells.observation: Front-facing fire pose; butt/rear stock sits near right shoulder/face, supporting hand beneath fore-end, dark barrel-mouth opening is visible above and to the right of the longer bayonet tip.

cells.name: BL loading
cells.observation: Distinct loading silhouette: small light cartridge-like object near the upright mouth, lower hand stabilizes weapon, both boots planted.

cells.name: BR ramming
cells.observation: Distinct ramming silhouette: raised right hand holds thin rod above muzzle and lower left hand steadies upright weapon; head/torso/toes keep S front.

measurementContract.coordinateSpace: Native per-cell pixels from cell top-left; TL/TR/BL/BR order. Bounds and sole Y are exclusive.
measurementContract.rootMeaning: Fresh manual concealed pelvis-center X projected to independently selected visible supporting boot sole Y in each cell. A 2D registration pivot, not recovered certified anatomical pelvis or physical ground.
measurementContract.groundMethod: Fresh visually selected alpha>=64 supporting-boot-only ROIs; root Y uses the exclusive bottom in each ROI. Ready/loading ROIs exclude the rifle butt: TL source-wide bottom583 is not used because boot-only sole is582; BL source-wide bottom568 is not used because selected boot sole is566. Paired planted boots and camera depth leave about3-pixel uncertainty.
measurementContract.capMethod: Fresh alpha>=64 minimum Y in manually selected cap crown regions, excluding upright rifle/ramrod and raised hand. BR region begins X310 to exclude raised rod-hand.
measurementContract.referenceMethod: Rounded median of four fresh cap-to-individual-supporting-sole spans; one whole-source scale and no per-phase scaling.
measurementContract.firingMouthMethod: Fresh close checkerboard crop inspection of actual dark barrel-mouth opening, independently distinguished from long bayonet. Targeted dark-pixel ROI supports opening location:58 alpha64 pixels with maxRGB<38, centroid242.28,342.09, but shaft-edge pixels mean this is supporting evidence rather than a certified geometric center.

limits: Acceptance binds only to this exact source SHA and all four inspected cells for local opt-in preview.
Four stationary poses do not establish verified historical loading/ramming drill or smooth ready-to-aim/loading transitions.
Hidden pelvis, fingertips, shoulder stock attachment and 2D supporting-foot ground estimates remain uncertain.
Native cap-to-supporting-sole spans vary by19pixels; the whole-source height502 retains variation.
Targeted red/yellow pixel test does not establish perfectly clean alpha or exhaustive absence of fringe.
Model-assisted review, not human, physical anatomy, historical equipment/drill, default, production or complete-family certification.
Temporal renderer, pauses/checkpoints, smoke lifetime, decoded/GPU/process residency and device performance remain separate checks.
registrationAssessment: Each stationary cell uses its own fresh visible supporting-sole registration; no source pixels changed. Source-wide bottoms are not automatically accepted as ground because rifle butts can extend lower.
